Jotio - Quick Scratch Pad

Summary
Jotio is a quick scratch pad for iPhone and Apple Watch. Capture fast, color-code notes, review them quickly, and let them auto-clear after 30 days so your mind stays light.

Key Features
- Fast capture for fleeting ideas
- Color-coded notes for visual organization
- Review interface for quick decisions
- Automatic cleanup after 30 days
- iCloud sync across devices
- Apple Watch capture

Positioning
Working memory, not a second brain. No folders, tags, or notebooks.

Ideal Use Cases
- Quick reminders and shopping notes
- Meeting notes that need action soon
- Temporary thoughts you don’t want to hoard

Primary Keywords
quick notes app, scratch pad, mental clarity, auto cleanup notes, color coded notes, iPhone notes app
